Name: Vyranity Pastry Oven
Author: Cinnamoff
Description:
[size=5][b]Vyranity Pastry Oven[/b][/size]
A dedicated baking station for Vyranity Mega Pack Continued, powered by Better Crafting. 

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]All recipes sorted into categories
[*]Exclusive station removes clutter from the main cooking menu
[*]Pulls ingredients from any container on the current map
[*]Available from Robin for 3,000g
[/list]
[size=4][b]Recipe Categories[/b][/size]
[b]Examples [/b]of category contents:
[list]
[*][b]Breads[/b]: Rye, Prismatic Bread
[*][b]Rolls & Donuts[/b]: Cinnamon rolls, glazed donuts, cake rolls
[*][b]Cakes[/b]: Fruit cakes, layered cakes, cupcakes
[*][b]Cookies & Biscuits[/b]: Chocolate chip cookie, gingerbread man
[*][b]Pastries[/b]: Croissants, turnovers, eclairs
[*][b]Pancakes, Waffles & Crepes[/b]: Berry crepes, waffles
[*][b]Savory Bakes[/b]: Meat pies, Cheese Stick
[*][b]Misc. Sweets[/b]: Fruit Muffin, Cranberry crumble
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAP[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34010]Vyranity Mega Pack Continued[/url]﻿﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]Recommended[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b][url=http://google.com][/url][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24845]Cooking Overhaul[/url] - Dynamically calculates food prices based on ingredients so your baked goods can be profitable!
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Vyranity – Original recipes and pastry sprites
[*]Shads4242 – Vyranity Mega Pack (Continued)
[*]Kath40 - Kitchen Station Sets, which inspired this mod
[*]KhloeLeclair – Better Crafting 
[*]Pathoschild – Content Patcher and SMAPI
[*]ConcernedApe - one of the best games in existence
[/list]
[i]This mod was only uploaded to NexusMods: [url=[https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34238](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34238)[/url] [/i]

Downloads.Description:
Made oven slightly shorter to align better with the vanilla kitchen counters
Decreased price to 1k to match KSS big craftables
Fixed position in carpenter's shop menu
Added translation support for category names
Updated manifest fields
